name: utuvo-guard
description: Guard / 防呆閘 — stops known agent mistakes before a Bash command runs (wrangler r2 without --remote, npm uninstall -g without --prefix, pkill -f rsync, self-matching pgrep waits, AppleScript content search in Mail) and protects original audio masters from being deleted, moved, overwritten or converted in place. Add `# guard-ok: <reason>` to override; everything is logged to ~/.local/log/utuvo-guard.log.
